recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片三格裡，大片淡紫色、蓬鬆雲霧狀的無定形物質佔滿視野中央，邊緣散布淋巴球、嗜中性球與少數漿細胞；低倍（下格）可見多團同樣物質連成一片，形態上提示類澱粉（amyloid）。
features: Broad sheets of extracellular amorphous, fluffy, cloud-like pale purple material
Deposits are acellular with smudgy, finely granular texture and indistinct feathery margins
Low-power strip (bottom) shows multiple confluent deposits across the smear
Admixed lymphocytes, granulocytes and occasional plasma cells at the edges of the deposits
Gray-staining red cell masses in thick areas of the smear
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears (three fields, two at high power and one at low power) show broad extracellular sheets of amorphous, fluffy, cloud-like pale purple material with granular texture and indistinct borders. Lymphocytes, granulocytes and occasional plasma cells are distributed along the margins of the deposits, and the low-power field shows multiple confluent deposits across the smear. These features are suggestive of amyloid on a Romanowsky-stained smear, but the appearance is not specific and Congo red confirmation with polarization is required. Findings are suggestive of bone marrow involvement by amyloidosis.

ddx.dx: Fibrin clot in a partially clotted aspirate
ddx.vs: Fibrin forms fibrillar meshworks that trap platelets and cells and is Congo red negative.
Appears as pale pink-purple mucoid background material in a hypocellular smear and is Alcian blue positive but Congo red negative.
A crushed particle contains smeared nuclei, chromatin strands and fat spaces rather than acellular homogeneous fluffy deposits.
